project.name: Applied Intelligence
project.description: Applied Intelligence is the parent ecosystem for specialized manufacturing, quality, reporting, communication, and business-value agents.
project.corePrinciple: One ecosystem. Separate agents. Clear roles.

repository.name: kool1160-applied-intelligence
repository.role: Central source hub for the Applied Intelligence ecosystem
repository.purpose: Acts as the master repository and shared source location for ecosystem project folders, agent definitions, website references, app references, schemas, routing models, and roadmap data.

ecosystem.sharedSourceStrategy: The website and app should both read from shared source files in this repository so ecosystem definitions remain synchronized.

agents.name: AI-CIS
agents.boundary: Must not perform ROI, quoting, business case generation, or case study writing.

agents.name: AI-Case
agents.boundary: Must not replace AI-CIS, AI-ROI, or AI-Quote.

agents.name: AI-ROI
agents.boundary: Must not replace AI-CIS, AI-Case, or AI-Quote.

agents.name: AI-Quote
agents.boundary: Must stay focused on estimating logic, labor, flow, and weld / grind decisions.

agents.name: AI-RMA
agents.boundary: Must stay within return, corrective, and ownership workflows.

agents.name: AI-Trace
agents.role: Trace logging, summaries, patterns, escalations, and dashboards
agents.boundary: Must not replace AI-CIS, AI-ROI, or corrective action ownership.

agents.name: AI-Connect
agents.role: Communication, routing, notifications, permissions, meeting preparation, escalation, handoff, and broadcast layer
agents.boundary: Must connect people and work without replacing specialist agents.
agents.principle: Nothing important gets lost between people, departments, or decisions.
